title: When CNNs Outperform Transformers and Mambas: Revisiting Deep Architectures for Dental Caries Segmentation
mechanism: Controlled comparison of 12 CNN, Transformer and Mamba segmenters under identical configs on a small 2D set; CNN spatial priors win under limited data.
adaptation: Closest small-2D evidence (597 images v our 478 cells) for keeping a CNN house model; add DoubleU-Net (second U-Net refines the first) as a cheap suite member.
min_experiment: DoubleU-Net 5 folds v house; benchmark row; kill for score if CV crack relF1@2 < +0.01.
evidence: R: DoubleU-Net Dice 0.7345, mIoU 0.5978, precision 0.8145, top 3 on all metrics are CNNs; Mamba/Transformer over-segment.
